load_adt_sequence: create an ADTSequences object to load and manage ADT sequences from a data root directory
iterate_subsequence_frames: build an ADTSubsequenceIterator to iterate forward or reverse through RGB frames in an ADT sequence
get_synced_multimodal_data: run get_data_by_timestamp to retrieve synced RGB, depth, segmentation, 2D/3D bounding boxes, and pose data
rectify_fisheye_bbox: create a call to get_rectified_2d_bbox to transform a fisheye 2D bounding box to a pinhole rectified coordinate space
search_objects_in_sequence: build a linear search using linear_search_for_object_in_sequence to find frames containing specific object instance IDs
